abstract: Dermoid cysts are benign cystic teratomas lined by skin and epidermal appendages. We report a dermoid cyst occurring in a 26-year-old female whose chief complaint was irregular vaginal bleeding. Abdominal magnetic resonance image demonstrated a space-occupying lesion in the right lower abdomen. The mass showed hyperintensity on the T2 image and the signal was homogeneous for the interior. During abdominal surgery we made the diagnosis of subserous tumor of the colon and resected the ileocecal portion of the colon. The tumor measured 5.4 x 4.8 x 3.5 cm and was soft and elastic. On cross section, a unilocular cyst filled with atheromatous material was found. Pathological examination revealed a dermoid cyst. In the view of this diagnosis, a simple excision would have been an adequate treatment.
abstract_ja: 類皮嚢腫は皮膚と皮膚付属器で覆われた良性の嚢胞性奇形腫である。26歳女性が不正性器出血を主訴に受診した。腹部MRIで右下腹部に占拠性病変を認め、T2強調画像で高信号、内部は均一であった。腹部手術中は結腸の漿膜下腫瘍と診断し、回盲部切除を行った。腫瘍は5.4×4.8×3.5cmで、柔らかく弾力性があった。割面では内部にアテローム様物質で満たされた単房性の嚢胞を認めた。病理学的検査で類皮嚢腫と診断された。この診断を踏まえると、単純切除で十分な治療となったと考えられる。
